description: L4-4: the 11e enemy stand-off for Infiltrators (24.20) and for reserves / Deep Strike arrivals (20.04 / 24.09) is 8", and the engine enforces 8", but player-facing text kept the 10e 9". Each is checked where it renders, through the real UI: (1) the Reserves panel (opened with its P keybinding) describes a Deep Strike arrival as 'more than 8" horizontally from enemy models'; (2) arming the Kommandos' Deep Strike placement from the Movement phase unit list draws the exclusion bubbles with the label '8" exclusion' (it said '9" exclusion' on 8" bubbles); (3) entering the Deployment phase shows the phase banner whose rules brief says Infiltrators deploy '>8" from the enemy deployment zone and enemy units' (captured with a direct frame grab: the runner's screenshot act hides this banner); (4) clicking the Kommandos (Infiltrators) in the deployment list draws the exclusion boundary labelled '8" exclusion'; (5) Settings > Controls names the 8" exclusion zone in the placement-clamp option and its help. The drawn label text is read from what the visual last drew (_last_label_text); for the captures the camera is framed on it and the cursor parked away (exclusion clamp briefly off so the ghost follows the cursor, then back on). No ERROR in the debug log. Fixture ri_pretrigger (Movement phase, battle round 2, P2 Orks to act); the Kommandos are switched to Deep Strike for parts 1-2 and back to undeployed for parts 3-4.

steps.script:

steps.script: tree.root.get_node_or_null("Main/ReservesPanel") == null

for i in range(list.item_count):

return false
